versionNote: Latest Java release as of 2026-09-27 is 26.3 (Wilderness Bound, released 2026-09-15). The anvil-relevant enchantment fields (anvil_cost, max_level, exclusive_set, supported_items, primary_items, weight, slots, min_cost, max_cost and the expanded item tags) are the same in 1.21.11, 26.1, 26.2, 26.3 and 26.4-snapshot-1; the files themselves are not identical. Bedrock latest: 26.52 (2026-09-25), 26.50 = Wilderness Bound.

rules.bookMultiplier: max(1, floor(itemMultiplier/2)) (Java AnvilMenu; wiki Enchantment_definition anvil_cost)
rules.compatibility: a and b are incompatible if b in a.exclusive_set OR a in b.exclusive_set (symmetric); an enchantment is never listed as exclusive with itself here
rules.applicability: Java: enchantment.supported_items (anvil + /enchant); target enchanted_book or Creative mode accepts anything
rules.javaCostPerEnchantment: multiplier * finalLevel; +1 per conflicting enchantment already on target

enchantments.bedrockDiff: In Bedrock, Bane of Arthropods does not conflict with Impaling (Java-only). Axe and Mace get it from the enchanting table in Bedrock (anvil-only in Java); anvil applicability is the same.
In Bedrock, Breach does not conflict with Impaling (Java-only book conflict). Bedrock Japanese name: 違反.
In Bedrock, Density does not conflict with Impaling (Java-only book conflict). Bedrock Japanese name: 密度.
Mace gets it from the enchanting table in Bedrock (anvil-only in Java); anvil applicability is the same.

Bedrock anvil multipliers are item 2 / book 1 (Java 4 / 2). In Bedrock, Impaling is NOT exclusive with Sharpness/Smite/Bane of Arthropods/Density/Breach (Java-only book conflict). Effect differs: Bedrock damages any mob in water/rain.

Bedrock multiplier not independently confirmed; minecraft.wiki Anvil mechanics table lists 1/1 for Loyalty without an edition note (that table also says 1/1 for Java, which contradicts the Java game data anvil_cost=2).
In Bedrock, Sharpness does not conflict with Impaling (Java-only). Axes get it from the enchanting table in Bedrock (anvil-only in Java); anvil applicability is the same.
Bedrock additionally allows Silk Touch on Shears via anvil (Java does not).
In Bedrock, Smite does not conflict with Impaling (Java-only). Axe and Mace get it from the enchanting table in Bedrock (anvil-only in Java); anvil applicability is the same.
Does not exist in Bedrock Edition (Java-only enchantment).
Bedrock offers Thorns on all armor pieces at the enchanting table (Java: chestplate only); anvil applicability is the same.
Bedrock additionally allows Curse of Vanishing on the Recovery Compass. Bedrock string ID: vanishing.

items.note: All helmet materials (leather, copper, chainmail, iron, golden, diamond, netherite).

Elytra is not armor: no Protection-family/Thorns.

All axe materials. Sharpness/Smite/Bane are anvil-only in Java.
Efficiency is anvil-only. Silk Touch only in Bedrock.
Smite/Bane/Fire Aspect are anvil-only in Java (table in Bedrock).
